items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: My father was a Teamster... my grandfather was a Temaster who had his own trucking business

ctx.x: My father was a Teamster, as they

were called in the days before trucking. He owned his own trucking business, and my grandfather was a Temaster who had his own trucking business, but that was before mobile automobiles, or trucks -- and I was born -- I was in the middle of the city of Portland, Maine, with my grandfolks, after my father and mother divorced, and I was brought up by my grandfolks.
